vocabulary.meaning: time when you are not working and can rest or relax
examples: Downtime is an important idea when discussing the benefits of doing nothing.
Learning about downtime can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: the state of not being active or busy
examples: People often have different views about idleness when discussing the benefits of doing nothing.
Understanding idleness can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: a period of relaxing in order to recover energy
examples: The topic of the benefits of doing nothing raises useful questions about rest.
We can discuss how rest affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: physical and emotional exhaustion caused by long-term stress or overwork
examples: Burnout can play an important role in debates about the benefits of doing nothing.
Different countries may deal with burnout in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: the amount of useful work achieved in a given time
examples: A discussion about the benefits of doing nothing can include the effects of productivity.
Knowing the meaning of productivity makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: a period of rest that helps restore attention and emotional energy
examples: Mental recharge is useful vocabulary for talking about the benefits of doing nothing.
We can use the idea of mental recharge to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
